technology_name: TRANSPARENT CONDUCTING HOLE INJECTING (HI) POLYMER ELASTOMER COMPOSITE MATERIAL FOR ORGANIC ELECTRONIC APPLICATIONS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Organic solar cells and flexible electronics lack lightweight, high-work-function transparent materials that maintain chemical stability over long lifespans.
description: Synthesis of a highly transparent (>85% visible spectrum light transmission) and highly conducting polymer composite film engineered with a work function of 5.2 eV and a low surface resistivity of 20 to 50 ohms per square.
applications: Organic Photovoltaics (OPV), Organic Field-Effect Transistors (OFETs), flexible smart window coatings, and next-generation touch screen glass assemblies.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
